title: The Runaway Bride
title_zh: 穿成恶毒女配后，我决定帮女主逃婚
synopsis: Jiang Mingyue wakes up inside a novel at the worst possible moment: she is about to drug the bride. The bride catches her in the act. To escape the fate written for her, Mingyue offers to help Wen Li avoid the wedding. But Wen Li may have a plan of her own.
